MFEprimer License and Terms
===========================

Runtime binary:
- DeepPrime/tools/bin/mfeprimer.exe

Detected runtime version:
- MFEprimer-4.2.4 (from `mfeprimer --help`)

- "MFEprimer (all the versions) source and executables are freely available for

- "Commercial licensing information please contact Dr. Chenggang Zhang."

Primary source:
- https://github.com/quwubin/MFEprimer-2.0
  (README section: "Copyright and license")

Additional project references:
- https://www.mfeprimer.com/

Release note:
- If a different MFEprimer build/version is bundled later, update this file to the exact
